description: This Java class provides utility functions for handling KeyStores and certificates, including loading, storing, and converting certificates and private keys, primarily used for SSL/TLS security management within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: KeyStoreUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing functions for managing Java KeyStores and certificates, such as loading, storing, converting to string, and importing certificates and keys.

methods.name: storeComponentKeyStore
methods.description: Stores a given KeyStore instance into a component-specific file location.

methods.name: getComponentKeyStore
methods.description: Retrieves a component-specific KeyStore based on component and keystore names.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Loads a KeyStore from a URL with specified password and type.

methods.name: getSystemTrustStore
methods.description: Retrieves the system's default trust store, typically used for SSL/TLS.

methods.name: readCertificate
methods.description: Creates an X.509 Certificate object from byte array.

methods.name: getCertX500Map
methods.description: Maps the subject's distinguished name fields from an X.509 certificate.

methods.name: importPKCS8CertChain
methods.description: Imports a private key and certificate chain into a KeyStore.

methods.name: certToString
methods.description: Converts a Certificate object into its PEM string representation.

methods.name: pemToCert
methods.description: Converts PEM formatted certificate string or file into a Certificate object.

methods.name: pemToCert
methods.description: Overloaded method to convert InputStream to Certificate.

methods.name: pemToCert
methods.description: Overloaded method to convert Reader to Certificate.

methods.name: pemToPkHex
methods.description: Extracts the public key from a PEM certificate and returns its hexadecimal representation.
